chapter: Willy Lewis band in Paris and Egypt
title: The bidet
summary: A comic story of Butler's puzzlement at the hotel bidet, finally explained by a lady friend.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: So this band -- stayed with this band, and this is where I began to get that European education. And especially, I went to the hotel and then got a thing called a bidet,
Yeah, bidet. And it's this round shape.
Yeah, I know what it is.
And it's especially for the ladies, it's a feminine thing. So --
It's a shower, an upside down shower.

And I looked at this thing and I said, I think I'd better go to the toilet and take care of business. So I -- about two or three weeks I had a lady friend visiting me and then she showed me -- I mean, she went and did what the bidet was made for. And I understood then. I understood perfectly. See, because every person that came to see that bidet, they didn't know what to do with that bidet. A lot of cats had done something awful, taking care of business in

in that bidet. (Laughter.) So then I come home now, I've got the job (inaudible). A lot of people were jealous people, all Latin people, they're loveable people but (inaudible). And if you stay away a long time, you become just like them.
